answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 15098 Country: Bangladesh Title: assala-mu a'laykum. there is any special sawm in the occasion of shab e meraz? and any special namaz? Question: assala-mu a'laykum. there is any special sawm in the occasion of shab e meraz? and any special namaz? Answer ID: 15098 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1263/1006=L/1430) There is no proof for any special salah or sawm in the night of Mairaj (celestial ascension). It is baseless to consider the sawm (fasting) of the day as ?hazari? fasting. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
